report.title: insights_cash_flow_monthly: C-107 fails bank reconciliation by 1,250.00
affected: C-107 (both customers it is shared with)
report.root_cause: The bank feed re-sent one C-107 payment of 1,250.00 on 2026-08-14 under a new transaction id (C-107-T00120, C-107-T00120-R). The MERGE key is (company_id, txn_id), so it landed as a second row and inflated the month's cash flow by 1,250.00.

evidence.claim: reconcile net_movement_all to source within 0.01 failed on 2 rows, all for C-107
bank lines sum to 52,866.69; the balance moved 51,616.69
2 lines share date, amount and description: C-107-T00120, C-107-T00120-R
lines by category: commerce_payout 120, loan_drawdown 1, own_transfer 4, payment 46, receipt 23

hypotheses.hypothesis: The feed re-sent a line under a new id
hypotheses.why: A same-day, same-amount pair exactly equals the difference.
Every other company reconciles to the penny with the same balance feed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A recent code or contract change
hypotheses.why: No recent change touches banking logic.

proposed_fix.summary: Quarantine a bank line that repeats an earlier line's account, date, amount and description within one day under a different id, and tell the source owner. Quarantine, not delete: a genuine second payment must stay reviewable.
proposed_fix.test: A bank line re-sent under a new id is quarantined, and the cash-flow reconciliation passes.

report.customer_impact: Cash flow for one company is overstated for one month; the product carries a caveat until fixed.
